name: Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela - Après le § 25 - Am 45
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 25b. Considers that devoting ever greater public resources to armaments diverts scarce budgetary resources from policies that directly improve people’s lives and strengthen social cohesion and societal resilience; calls for priority to be given to programmes supporting education, healthcare, affordable housing, social protection, support for families, quality employment, small and medium-sized enterprises and the ecological transition, particularly at a time when households and businesses are facing sustained economic and social pressures;
